slides.works_in: Any deck with red in it
slides.hook: Red's answer to anything. Enchantment, artifact, planeswalker, land — pick one, it's gone.

reasons.text: Red normally can't touch enchantments. This one touches everything.
It's a shuffle, not a destroy. Indestructible and regenerate do nothing about it.
Instant speed for three mana, and it's one of the cheapest cards in the format.

slides.watch_out: They reveal the top card and a permanent hits play. Sometimes you trade their worst card for their best.
